title: Gavampati

  • Catutthavagga Chapter Four

Gavampatittheragāthā Gavampati

“Yo iddhiyā sarabhuṁ aṭṭhapesi, His psychic power made the Sarabhū River stand still; So gavampati asito anejo; Gavampati is unbound and unperturbed. Taṁ sabbasaṅgātigataṁ mahāmuniṁ, The gods bow to that great sage, who has slipped all chains, Devā namassanti bhavassa pāragun”ti. and gone beyond rebirth.

… Gavampatitthero ….
